Census: the three parameterized pinned-overlap tests count stroke-adjacent samples, retain their hit owners, and report minimum path-to-node distance, node bounds, screen CTM, and canvas bounds before another sampling change.
samplingCorrections.finding: Natural subflow hit stacks still put the parent first because Vanilla added 1 to every node level. Removing that offset fixes painted overlaps.
